column1: # Credential inventory for THIS installation. Rendered into instance/README.md by
# tools/instance/index.ts.
# WHAT THIS FILE IS: the answer to "which credentials exist and where do they
# live", so that question stops being re-asked of the operator (HR-735) and so a
# rebuild knows what it must be handed. instructions/reproducible-from-git.md
# requires exactly this: host state that must NOT be in git is enumerated
# instead, because "not in git" is never allowed to mean "not written down".
# WHAT THIS FILE IS NOT: a runbook. Required scope, rotation procedure and a
# per-credential verification command are workboard row V3-2.10, still open.
# This file names what exists and where; it does not prove any of it works.
# NEVER a value. Not a token, not a key, not a secret fragment, not a password —
# only a location, a non-secret identity, and a purpose. A value here would be a
# Hard Floor 4 breach and the landing gate's secret scan would refuse it.
# Format: id<TAB>location<TAB>identity<TAB>purpose<TAB>provenance. Five non-empty
# tab-separated fields; `-` where a field does not apply. Lines starting with #
# are comments.
github-ssh
column4: SSH key this box uses for the GitHub remote named in params.yaml (repos.git_remote); the public half sits beside it

column1: github-api-token
column4: REST credential tools/check-github-ref-protection.sh needs to read branch protection; when it is absent the checker fails closed with reason=credential-missing

column1: google-service-account
column4: the machine's OWN Google Drive identity, as distinct from the interactive Drive connection on an orchestrator session (HR-2171); a Drive folder must be shared TO this address for the operator to see what it writes, and it must never be backed up to the Drive it authenticates to

column1: google-oauth-client
column4: OAuth client id and secret for the PRODUCT's Google integration; not used by the control plane

column1: qbo-oauth-client
column4: OAuth client id and secret plus environment/realm hint for the PRODUCT's QuickBooks integration; not used by the control plane

column1: claude-login
column4: Claude provider subscription login; the launch preflight reads it structurally via ORCH_CLAUDE_CRED_FILE and refuses to start when it does not prove subscription login

column1: codex-login
column3: owned by the bpa service user, not root
column4: Codex provider subscription login; the launch preflight reads it structurally via ORCH_CODEX_AUTH_FILE

column1: telegram-bot
column4: bot token and chat binding the Telegram daemon runs on; gitignored by design, its tracked contract is orchestrator/runtime.env.example and its install-time placeholder is bootstrap/env.template

column1: legacy-orchestrator-env
column4: the v1 control plane's environment file, still named as ENV_FILE by every rendered systemd unit (bootstrap/unit-render-lib.sh); its .bak-20260730 sibling is known to be secret-bearing and must not leave this host
